description: Mention-velocity tracker for collated trader opinions. Each narrative groups multiple mentions by canonical narrative_key. Heat score = distinct days with ≥1 mention / 7. Badge fires at heat ≥ 0.4 (3+ days of last 7).

narratives.current_thesis: Power, not compute, is the primary AI buildout constraint. Energy capex now competing with accelerators for AI allocation share.

mentions.gist: All four hyperscalers (MSFT/META/GOOGL/AMZN) said 'power and compute constrained' in unison
Hyperscaler capex commitments funnel to power buildout — multi-year cycle

AI Energy is becoming the primary conviction play. Power is the defining constraint of the AI buildout — not compute. Energy could dominate AI allocations above and beyond accelerators or networking. BE GEV VRT IREN

narratives.current_thesis: AI memory cycle is structural through 2027-2028, not cyclical. NAND/HBM supply pre-booked with multi-year contracts, customer prepayments, financial guarantees.

mentions.gist: AMZN Jassy: memory and storage costs have skyrocketed, with memory under the most pressure. Not enough capacity for current demand.
Samsung: 2027 demand already pre-booked. Supply-demand gap widens vs 2026.
SNDK Q3 FY26: 78% GM, $11B in customer financial guarantees, $42B contractual revenue. NAND moves from spot commodity to strategic input.
AI Memory is printing historic numbers. MU and SNDK not cyclical anymore. Supply constrained through 2028. Demand accelerating faster than any model projected.
Memory demand rising as CPU booms. NVDA Vera Rubin = 288GB HBM, INTC Xeon + AMD Epyc = up to 400GB DDR5. Structural change, not cyclical upcycle. Repricing of memory stocks looks inevitable.

narratives.current_thesis: AI workload shift from training → inference + agents drives CPU:GPU ratio from 1:8 toward 1:2 or 1:1 over time. CPU TAM expansion as inference scales — INTC/AMD/ARM are the direct beneficiaries; second-order benefit is even more memory per node.

mentions.gist: As we move from AI training to inference and agents, CPU:GPU ratio moves from 1:8 → 1:2 or 1:1. INTC/AMD/ARM benefit. Confirms memory supercycle is far from over (more compute per node = more memory per node).

narratives.current_thesis: Copper-to-optics transition (silicon photonics, EML lasers, co-packaged optics) is the highest-conviction networking thesis. Test/inspection + assembly bottlenecks where margin sits.

mentions.gist: Photonics supply chain analysis: bottlenecks live in TEST + ASSEMBLY, not raw materials. CPO transition shifts value to advanced packaging + fiber attach.
SIVE-B Apple silicon-photonics speculative thesis: 50M units/yr RFQ + 135-wavelength architecture triangulates to Apple Watch wearables.

The copper-to-optics transition is the highest conviction networking theme right now. Silicon photonics, EML lasers, co-packaged optics — the infrastructure layer most investors can't name is where the returns are. LITE AAOI SIVE IQE

narratives.current_thesis: Wafer test/inspection is the leading indicator + margin choke point for memory + photonics + advanced packaging ramps. Earnings prints from VIAV/FORM/SNDK validate.

mentions.gist: VIAV + FORM Q1 beats. FORM 49% gross margin = pricing power. Bullish read for downstream optical + memory ramps.
SNDK Q3 read-through: WFE upside more limited than memory earnings imply. Test/inspection > deposition.

narratives.current_thesis: Hyperscaler capex prints stay strong. META raised guide mid-year. MSFT 'miss' was supply-side bottleneck, not demand. AMZN ~$200B Jassy guide.

mentions.gist: META FY26 capex raised to $125-145B (from $115-135B). MSFT capex 'miss' = supply constrained, not demand. AMZN ~$200B Jassy guide.

narratives.current_thesis: Jassy's 'once-in-a-lifetime' framing for AWS + Trainium + Graviton signals multi-year compounder, not cyclical play. Custom silicon ASIC TAM expansion benefits AVGO/MRVL.

mentions.gist: Jassy: AWS + Trainium + Graviton + core AWS = once-in-a-lifetime opportunity. Amazon and shareholders will be very well off.

narratives.current_thesis: GOOGL re-rating on full-stack AI monetization (TPU + GCP + Gemini + Search/YouTube ad surface). Vertical-integration premium emerging vs single-layer AI names.

mentions.gist: GOOGL +7% — market rewarding the most vertically-integrated AI story in mega-cap. TPU + GCP + Gemini + Search/YouTube + Ads + Workspace.
